title: Human Anatomy III
modules: Anatomy Of The Diaphragm And Mediastinum
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a clotting factor that constitutes 4% of plasma proteins."
Fibrinogen is a clotting factor that constitutes 4% of plasma proteins.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to differentiate them from muscular arteries."
Size is used to differentiate them from muscular arteries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to make bile, which is needed for the digestion of fats."
Bilirubin is used to make bile, which is needed for the digestion of fats.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the introduction of air into the pleural cavity."
A pneumothorax is the introduction of air into the pleural cavity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the common passageway of both the digestive and the respiratory systems."
The pharynx is the common passageway of both the digestive and the respiratory systems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bony plate covered by a mucous membrane that forms the floor of the nasal cavity."
The hard palate is a bony plate covered by a mucous membrane that forms the floor of the nasal cavity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an enlarged segment of the digestive tract in the left superior part of the abdomen."
The stomach is an enlarged segment of the digestive tract in the left superior part of the abdomen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the failure of a valve to open fully, slowing blood flow from a chamber."
Stenosis is the failure of a valve to open fully, slowing blood flow from a chamber.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method of graphically recording the position and motion of the heart by the echo obtained from beams of ultrasonic waves directed through the thoracic wall."

Echocardiography (ultrasonic cardiography) is a method of graphically recording the position and motion of the heart by the echo obtained from beams of ultrasonic waves directed through the thoracic wall.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the respiratory diverticulum or the lung bud."
The outgrowth of tissue is called the respiratory diverticulum or the lung bud.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a space behind the heart, between the left atrium in front and the fibrous pericardium behind, posterior to which lies the oesophagus."
The oblique sinus is a space behind the heart, between the left atrium in front and the fibrous pericardium behind, posterior to which lies the oesophagus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the visible structure that forms a prominent feature of the face."
The external nose is the visible structure that forms a prominent feature of the face.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the only structures to filter lymph."
Lymph nodes are the only structures to filter lymph.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a pale yellow fluid that consists of about 91% water; 7% proteins; and 2% other substances, such as ions, nutrients, gases, and waste products."
Plasma is a pale yellow fluid that consists of about 91% water; 7% proteins; and 2% other substances, such as ions, nutrients, gases, and waste products.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bi-lobed gland located in the superior mediastinum, the partition dividing the thoracic cavity into left and right parts."
The thymus is a bi-lobed gland located in the superior mediastinum, the partition dividing the thoracic cavity into left and right parts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the primary muscle of respiration."
The diaphragm is the primary muscle of respiration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an accumulation of platelets that can seal up a smallbreak in a blood vessel."
A platelet plug is an accumulation of platelets that can seal up a smallbreak in a blood vessel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a third and slightly marked impression, lying between it and the neck of the gall-bladder."
Medial to the renal impression is a third and slightly marked impression, lying between it and the neck of the gall-bladder.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most frequent valve abnormality."
Aortic valve stenosis is the most frequent valve abnormality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the portion of the digestive tract extending from the ileocecal junction to the anus."
The large intestine is the portion of the digestive tract extending from the ileocecal junction to the anus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called oxyhemoglobin and is bright red in colour; hemoglobin carries carbodioxide is called deoxyhemoglobin and has a darker red color."
Hemoglobin that carries oxygen is called oxyhemoglobin and is bright red in colour; hemoglobin carries carbodioxide is called deoxyhemoglobin and has a darker red color.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basic structural unit of gas exchange in the lung."
The pulmonary alveolus is the basic structural unit of gas exchange in the lung.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of strong fibroareolar tissue, with a certain amount of muscular tissue, arranged, for the most part, in a circular manner around the duct."
The fibrous coat is composed of strong fibroareolar tissue, with a certain amount of muscular tissue, arranged, for the most part, in a circular manner around the duct.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of a single layer of endothelial cells."
The walls are composed of a single layer of endothelial cells.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are derived from the celiac plexus."
The nerves are derived from the celiac plexus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the vital organs of respiration."
The lungs are the vital organs of respiration.
fib: ______ is an inflammation of the mucous membrane of any sinus, especially of one or more paranasal sinuses.
Sinusitis
Sinusitis is an inflammation of the mucous membrane of any sinus, especially of one or more paranasal sinuses.
______ is a network of thread-like protein fibers called fibrin that traps blood cells, platelets and fluids.
blood clot
A blood clot is a network of thread-like protein fibers called fibrin that traps blood cells, platelets and fluids.
______ are the red blood cells (RBCs), or erythrocytes, the five types of white blood cells (WBCs) or leukocytes and the Platelets or thrombocytes.
formed elements
The formed elements are the red blood cells (RBCs), or erythrocytes, the five types of white blood cells (WBCs) or leukocytes and the Platelets or thrombocytes.
______ refer to the heart as if it were the seat of certain strong emotions.
People often
People often refer to the heart as if it were the seat of certain strong emotions.
______ is the main tributary of the coronary sinus.
great cardiac vein
The great cardiac vein is the main tributary of the coronary sinus.
______ are concerned with the metabolism of both nitrogenous and carbohydrate materials absorbed from the intestine and carried to the liver by the portal vein.
internal secretions
The internal secretions are concerned with the metabolism of both nitrogenous and carbohydrate materials absorbed from the intestine and carried to the liver by the portal vein.

III
Human Anatomy (III) is the second of three courses that covers the major organs that are responsible for life.
______ is a fibrous cord resulting from the obliteration of the umbilical vein.
round ligament (ligamentumtereshepatis)
round ligament
The round ligament (ligamentumtereshepatis) is a fibrous cord resulting from the obliteration of the umbilical vein.
______ is a fairly short tube (10-12 cm) with a diameter of ~2 cm consisting of Epithelium, Mucosa and Submucosa.
trachea
The trachea is a fairly short tube (10-12 cm) with a diameter of ~2 cm consisting of Epithelium, Mucosa and Submucosa.
______ is the main site of histological specialisations in the walls of arteries.
tunica media
The tunica media is the main site of histological specialisations in the walls of arteries.
______ is an immediate but temporary constriction of a blood vessel resulting from a contraction of smooth muscle within the wall of the vessel.
Vascular spasm
Vascular spasm is an immediate but temporary constriction of a blood vessel resulting from a contraction of smooth muscle within the wall of the vessel.
______ is a convoluted tube, extending from the pylorus to the colic valve, where it ends in the large intestine.
small intestine
The small intestine is a convoluted tube, extending from the pylorus to the colic valve, where it ends in the large intestine.
______ are the terminal segments of the conductive portion.
Bronchioles
Bronchioles are the terminal segments of the conductive portion.
______ is responsible for regulating the production of red blood cells.
hormone erythropoietin
The hormone erythropoietin is responsible for regulating the production of red blood cells.
______ is derived from the internal thoracic artery, its pericardiophrenic and musculophrenic branches, bronchial arteries and the thoracic aorta.
Pericardial blood supply
Pericardial blood supply is derived from the internal thoracic artery, its pericardiophrenic and musculophrenic branches, bronchial arteries and the thoracic aorta.
______ is a small elevation of the hepatic substance extending obliquely lateralward, from the lower extremity of the caudate lobe to the under surface of the right lobe.
caudate process
The caudate process is a small elevation of the hepatic substance extending obliquely lateralward, from the lower extremity of the caudate lobe to the under surface of the right lobe.
______ are a type of white blood cell.
Lymphocytes
Lymphocytes are a type of white blood cell.
______ is the removal of the palatine tonsils, and an adenoidectomy is the removal of the adenoid.
tonsillectomy
A tonsillectomy is the removal of the palatine tonsils, and an adenoidectomy is the removal of the adenoid.
______ is a biological pump that works with miles of blood vessels to supply nutrients, oxygen and also take wastes away to other systems for disposal.
heart
The heart is a biological pump that works with miles of blood vessels to supply nutrients, oxygen and also take wastes away to other systems for disposal.
______ is the broadest part of the interpleural space.
Middle Mediastinum
The Middle Mediastinum is the broadest part of the interpleural space.
______ is a type of connective tissue consisting of cells and cell fragments surrounded by a liquid matrix.
Blood
Blood is a type of connective tissue consisting of cells and cell fragments surrounded by a liquid matrix.
______ is a broad and thin antero-posterior peritoneal fold, falciform in shape, its base being directed downward and backward, its apex upward and backward.
falciform ligament (ligamentumfalciformehepatis)
falciform ligament

The falciform ligament (ligamentumfalciformehepatis) is a broad and thin antero-posterior peritoneal fold, falciform in shape, its base being directed downward and backward, its apex upward and backward.
______ is a protein first discovered on red blood cells of the Rhesus monkey, hence the name Rhesus.
Rh antigen
The Rh antigen is a protein first discovered on red blood cells of the Rhesus monkey, hence the name Rhesus.
______ is a passageway called a meatus.
Beneath each concha
Beneath each concha is a passageway called a meatus.
______ is a partition of bone and cartilage dividing the nasal cavity into right and left parts.
nasal septum
The nasal septum is a partition of bone and cartilage dividing the nasal cavity into right and left parts.
